name: Odometer counter
purpose: A mechanical-counter number: one rolling digit column per place, lower places roll continuously and a higher place turns over only while the place below passes from 9 to 0; the box is as wide as the largest value it is sent to, so it never reflows.

implementation.api: Studio.type.counterRoll(parent, {value, digits, decimals, group, prefix, suffix, pad}) -> {el, to(tl, value, at, {duration, ease}), value()}; call to() in time order

layout_notes: Inline, tabular digits; the size comes from the parent's font size (set it in --u). Seek-safe: GSAP tweens one number whose setter places the columns.
validation_steps: python tests/test-studio-runtime.py (columns grow to the largest value, exact digits after a roll, leading columns hide on the way down)

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-24. Not rendered through HyperFrames.
